title: I kept thinking about why....
content_text: I kept thinking about why. The thing is, most films push you forward with tension — you're gripped, then drained. This one moves like a tide: war, hunger, loss, and each time, Scarlett simply refuses to stay down. Looking back, that's what makes it timeless. It's not really a story about what happens to her; it's about the fact that she survives it. Anyway — highly recommend it, even today.
